page.overview:
Who is Colorful Gallimimus?

The colorful Gallimimus is a genetically modified hybrid of Gallimimus and tree frog that appears in Minecraft Jurassic World.

A colorful variant of the Gallimimus can be created in the game. In order to create it, a player must acquire 3 samples of Gallimimus DNA; 2 samples of any Medium DNA; and 1 sample of Tree Frog DNA.
